recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-30632; any deletion of the inactive source/entrydefinition directory would be repository hygiene rather than a required spec fix.
issue_request: FHIR-30632 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core EntryDefinition/CatalogEntry. It asked to remove CatalogEntry, but the approved resolution was to keep it temporarily and add a note warning of intended R5 removal, soliciting implementer comments, and linking the Catalog IG.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-30632. The current repository still has stale source/entrydefinition files, but source/fhir.ini has no active catalogentry or entrydefinition entry, so those files are not current build inputs.
additional_context: The January 2021 Zulip and OO WGM evidence shows the Catalog project considered CatalogEntry abandoned/deprecated and that the Order Catalog IG did not use it. The later Published/Persuasive FHIR-28177 decision removed CatalogEntry from the active build before R5, and current history lists it as an R5 removed resource.
reconciliation: No source change was made because adding the old warning now would only affect inactive source files, while the active specification already reflects removal. The remaining references in history.html and fhir-old-types are appropriate historical references.
